architecture.model_responsibility: infer bounded evidence with component-local scores and provenance
architecture.compiler_responsibility: construct exact versioned credential graph or typed failure
architecture.policy_responsibility: future training-only derivation over independently eligible credential atom types

candidate_shortlist.selection_rationale: one compositional detector-plus-contrastive pipeline and one end-to-end scene-graph pipeline test distinct observation assumptions without arbitrary VLM-to-JSON generation
candidate_shortlist.replacement_rule: no replacement after any validation output; a licensing or acquisition failure is a recorded pipeline failure, not permission to add a candidate

A_controlled_geometric.source: project-authored deterministic geometric/composited fixtures with exact boxes and compiler-edge cases

B_naturalistic_t2i.source: new project-authored prompts rendered later by the intended local authentication generator; independent visual annotation precedes perception inference

generator.seed_rule: committed family/image identifier derivation before generation

B_naturalistic_t2i.annotation: two project researchers independently label visible facts without model outputs; disagreements are adjudicated before inference; agreement is reported descriptively

dataset.sealed_reconstruction_data: P9-v3C must author a separate dataset and preregistration; capability validation images never become reconstruction test images
dataset.licence_rule: exclude any source whose image-level reuse terms or provenance cannot be recorded

compiler_tests.failure_rule: any compiler invariant failure blocks Gate V3-A1 regardless of perception metrics

perception_metrics.entity_match: category-equal one-to-one Hungarian assignment at IoU >= 0.50
secondary: 10-bin ECE within each component score domain
perception_metrics.invalid_or_typed_failure_scoring: all reference facts count as false negatives; no predicted false positives are imputed
perception_metrics.abstention_scoring: abstained applicable facts count as false negatives for recall and reduce coverage; abstention is not a crash
perception_metrics.coverage_definition: applicable reference opportunities receiving a non-abstained type prediction divided by all applicable reference opportunities
perception_metrics.pipeline_failure_rate_definition: validation images ending in a required-component or compiler typed failure divided by all validation images
perception_metrics.duplicate_rule: score only compiler-normalised observations; also report pre-compiler duplicate rate
perception_metrics.stratum_rule: each eligibility threshold must pass separately in A and B; pooled performance cannot rescue a failed stratum

uncertainty.multiple_types: report all planned types; eligibility is conjunctive per type and stratum, with no p-value selection

repeatability.canonical_observation_projection: visual_observation_v3.json observation_canonicalisation; volatile timing, memory, timestamps, and paths excluded

compute.development_machine: compiler tests, manifest/schema audit, and at most two predeclared tiny smoke images with reduced components; no full inference claim
compute.full_inference_machine: one documented local or dedicated research GPU with at most 24 GiB VRAM and 32 GiB system RAM; no secret-bearing cloud service
compute.smoke_rule: two development images per pipeline; smoke may find plumbing/OOM/licence failure but may not tune labels, prompts, thresholds, or candidate identity

gate_v3_a1.name: modular extraction viability
gate_v3_a1.action_relation_rule: unary_action and binary_interaction are evaluated and may enter L_cred only on their own evidence; neither is mandatory for Gate V3-A1 and neither is discarded by design
gate_v3_a1.pass_rule: at least one frozen pipeline passes compiler, operational, resource, repeatability, and minimum eligible-language requirements
gate_v3_a1.failure_rule: if no pipeline passes, stop the visual constructive path or preregister a genuinely new reframe; do not execute P9-v3C

future_gate_v3_a2.name: independent visual reconstruction viability
future_gate_v3_a2.status: future P9-v3C; no execution or tuning in P9-v3A
future_gate_v3_a2.pass_rule: all checks pass on a separate preregistered reconstruction dataset using only Gate V3-A1-eligible atom types
future_gate_v3_a2.meaning: technical reconstruction feasibility only; not memorability, usability, entropy, attack resistance, or privacy

stop_rules: licence or provenance ambiguity fails closed
no candidate replacement after validation output
no validation-driven label, score threshold, prompt, NMS, geometry, compiler, or type change
one compiler invariant failure blocks Gate V3-A1
logical futility may stop remaining inference only when a conjunctive gate is mathematically impossible; report every unestimated metric
P9-v3B requires explicit user authorisation after P9-v3A
P9-v3C requires constructive Gate V3-A1 and a separate preregistration
P10 remains blocked until constructive Gate V3-A2

preserved_claims.C1: technical stability of independent generative visual reconstruction, conditional on V3-A1 and V3-A2
preserved_claims.C2: incremental systems evidence for typed system-derived M/T policy, not standalone novelty
preserved_claims.C4: construction-specific private, policy-hiding, offline-resistant-under-declared-views, domain-separated and unlinkable verification
